en.title: Government Building Approved Despite Accessibility Fears Highlights Disability Policy Tensions
en.summary: A billion-dollar government building secured approval despite accessibility concerns, sparking debate over priorities in public spending. Meanwhile, the PSVAR deadline for coach operators to make vehicles disability-compliant approaches, urging rapid retrofits. In other news, Dove Healthcare rolled out an accessible golf cart for residents, while a Paralympian praised station upgrades and an AudioEye report warned of AI search accessibility risks.

highlights.title: Billion-Dollar Government Building Approved Despite Accessibility Concerns Amid Rising Medical Costs
PSVAR Deadline Approaches for Coach Operators
Dove Healthcare residents get accessible golf cart
AudioEye Report Reveals AI Search Accessibility Risks

zh-TW.title: 億豪大樓獲批 無障礙質疑 PSVAR期限近
zh-TW.summary: 億豪政府大樓在醫療費用上漲、民生支出縮減的情況下仍獲無障礙審查通過，引發公共資源分配爭議。同時，PSVAR截止日期將至，巴士營運者需盡快完成車輛改裝以符合殘障人士無障礙需求。此外，Dove Healthcare 提供無障礙高爾夫球車提升居民行動能力，日本國會議員倡導無障礙與普遍設計，AudioEye 報告警告 AI 搜尋可能存在無障礙風險。

highlights.title: 百億豪建政府大樓，但醫療加價、民生縮？項目竟可無障礙通過反映些甚麼？
PSVAR 截止日期將至，巴士營運者需完成車輛改裝以符合無障礙規範
Dove Healthcare 為居民提供無障礙高爾夫球車
日本國會議員在視障福利文化祭上倡導無障礙與普遍設計
AudioEye 報告揭示 AI 搜尋無障礙風險
